A '''double viol''' was a stringed [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument, consisting of two hollow resonating boxes separated by a shaft with tonal cords strung on it. It was the favored musical instrument of [[Tionne Solusar]], who took her [[Tionne Solusar's grandmother|grandmother's]] double viol with her while fleeing [[Rindao]].

Solusar was able to make a living performing on the instrument at [[Cantina]]s and, in return, asked patrons to share any knowledge they had of the former [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. This eventually led to her meeting with Jedi Grand Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] herself. 

At the [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi Academy]], she would often teach trainees through her songs, while accompanying herself on the instrument.
